import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, traceback
folder = pathlib.Path("/data/ycfeng/Frontier/.worktrees/step5-preview/task_memory/task_2026-10-22_step5_position_routing/resumed_execution/evidence/execution_preparation_2026-10-25")
plan = json.loads((folder / "worker_plan.json").read_bytes())
source = pathlib.Path(plan["source_root"])
report = {"uid": os.getuid(), "gid": os.getgid(), "source_uid": source.stat().st_uid, "source_gid": source.stat().st_gid, "status": "IN_PROGRESS", "new_pricing_calls": 0, "new_shape_calls": 0, "new_platform_operations": 0, "asset_hashes": {}}
try:
    for filename, expected in plan["git"]["files"].items():
        actual = hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        report["asset_hashes"][filename] = actual
        assert actual == expected, filename
    os.environ["PATH"] = str(pathlib.Path(plan["git"]["path"]).parent) + os.pathsep + os.environ["PATH"]
    os.environ["GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL"] = plan["git"]["config"]
    assert shutil.which("git") == plan["git"]["path"]
    report["git"] = shutil.which("git")
    report["git_version"] = subprocess.check_output(["git", "--version"], text=True).strip()
    assert report["git_version"] == plan["git"]["version"]
    report["safe_directories"] = subprocess.check_output(["git", "config", "--global", "--get-all", "safe.directory"], text=True).splitlines()
    assert report["safe_directories"] == [str(source), str(source / "frontier/cc_backend/backends/collective-sim")]
    report["safe_directory_origins"] = subprocess.check_output(["git", "config", "--show-origin", "--global", "--get-all", "safe.directory"], text=True).splitlines()
    sys.path.insert(0, str(folder))
    from joint_timing import check_bindings
    bindings = json.loads(pathlib.Path(plan["joint_bindings"]).read_bytes())
    report["source"] = check_bindings(bindings, folder)
    assert check_bindings(bindings, folder) == report["source"]
    report["status"] = "PASS_FIXED_IMAGE_COPIED_GIT_AND_REAL_SOURCE_BINDINGS_ONLY"
except BaseException as error:
    report["status"] = "FAIL"
    report["error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2), flush=True)
    raise
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))

Real check_bindings must pass without source/setup/pricing or host/image config changes.
scope: Fixed-image read-only Git/source binding check only; no model setup/runtime probe/pricing/shape/platform
